_comment: The next card you play this turn with cost 2 or less and an arcane-damage effect instead deals that much +1; Go again. Modeled as AMP 1 (engine's 'next arcane damage this turn +N', CR 8.5.47) + GO_AGAIN. The 'cost 2 or less' restriction on which card is simplified/omitted (Amp buffs the next arcane damage regardless of the source card's cost). Prior JSON used a malformed nested APPLY_CONTINUOUS that implemented nothing.
